name: Command menu
summary: Search across pages and actions with the keyboard, opened with ⌘K or Ctrl+K. Results is a native Figma slot with Command items.
use: Apps with many pages or actions, for experienced users.
avoid: As the only way to find something: always add visible navigation too.
anatomy: Search field with an Esc hint.
Results (slot): group headings and Command items.
figmaProps: Active = highlighted with the arrow keys.
Command item: Icon / Label / Show shortcut
reactProps: { id, label, group?, icon?, shortcut?, keywords?, disabled?, onSelect }[]
behaviour: Typing filters by label and keywords.
Arrow up/down highlights, Enter runs the item and closes, Escape closes.
a11y: Combobox (input) with a listbox. aria-activedescendant follows the highlight, so focus stays in the search field.
Empty results are announced with role="status".
content: Labels as a verb for actions ("New project"), as a name for pages.
do: Add keywords for words with the same meaning.
